entries.source: StAN, Reichsstadt Rothenburg, Akten und Bände (Bauernkriegsakten) – Systematisches Repertorium 337/fol. 216–217a
entries.german: Rothenburg an Konrad Eberhart und Jörg Bermetter sowie den Stadtschreiber Thomas Zweifel: Streit Rothenburgs mit Zaisolph von Rosenberg und den Lochingern.
entries.english: Rothenburg wrote to Konrad Eberhard, Jörg Bermetter, and town clerk Thomas Zweifel concerning Rothenburg’s dispute with Zaisolph von Rosenberg and the Lochingers.

facts.content: was named as an opponent in a dispute between Rothenburg and the Lochingers, about which the city wrote to Konrad Eberhard, Jörg Bermetter, and town clerk Thomas Zweifel.
